context_for_next_testing_agent: Permission scoping bug fix verified. Key change: is_network_admin NO LONGER implies is_system_admin. Only is_primary_network_admin=true OR is_system_admin=true makes a user system admin. System admin (admkoodh@koodh.com) correctly sees all environments (Production + Staging), all 11 main sites, and all Network Dashboard sidebar sections. Environment admins would only see their assigned environments/sites (not directly testable without creating test environment admin user). Anti-cache headers verified on all /api responses.
